# topological

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:frameKindTopological`](gmeow-frameKindTopological.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameKindTopological>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A frame whose structure is defined by containment, adjacency, or graph connectivity rather than geometric coordinates. Distance is measured in hops or nesting depth, not metres or degrees.
